replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, especially when problems get complex or abstract. My high neuroticism (84) makes me stressed by uncertainty in math, like when I’m stuck on a problem without clear steps. I try to break it into smaller parts to reduce anxiety.
